actions.create-form-entry.description: Submit a new entry to a Wufoo form with dynamic field selection.
actions.create-form-entry.props.formFiel: Fill out the form fields with the data you want to submit. Field types and validation are automatically configured based on your form structure.
actions.create-form-entry.props.formIden: Select a Wufoo form to work with.
actions.create-form-entry.props.format.d: Choose the format for the API response. JSON is recommended for most use cases.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find-form.description: Get details about a Wufoo form including settings, entry counts, and metadata.
actions.find-form.displayName: Find Form by Name or Hash
actions.find-form.props.formIdentifier.d: Select a Wufoo form to work with.
actions.find-form.props.format.descripti: Choose the format for the API response. JSON is recommended for most integrations.
actions.find-form.props.includeTodayCoun: Include the number of entries submitted today in the response. Useful for daily analytics and monitoring.
actions.find-submission-by-field.descrip: Search for form submissions by field value for deduplication and lookup operations.
actions.find-submission-by-field.props.f: The form field to search in (e.g., Field1 for first name, Field218 for email). You can find Field IDs in the form builder or via the Form Fields API.
Select a Wufoo form to work with.
Choose the format for the API response. JSON is recommended for most workflows.
actions.find-submission-by-field.props.i: Include additional information like submission date, IP address, and creation details.
actions.find-submission-by-field.props.m: How to match the search value with field data. Choose based on your use case.
Limit the number of results returned (1-50). Lower numbers are faster for deduplication checks.
actions.find-submission-by-field.props.s: The value to search for in the specified field. For exact matches, use the complete value.
Order to return results. "Newest First" is best for finding recent duplicates.
actions.get-entry-details.description: Get form entries with filtering, sorting, and pagination options.
actions.get-entry-details.props.addition: Add a second filter field for more complex queries.
Enter a specific Entry ID to retrieve just that entry. Leave blank to get multiple entries with other filters.
actions.get-entry-details.props.filterFi: The field ID to filter by (e.g., Field1, Field105, EntryId, DateCreated). Leave blank for no filtering.
actions.get-entry-details.props.filterLo: How to combine multiple filters. Only applies when using multiple filters.
actions.get-entry-details.props.filterOp: How to compare the filter value with the field data.
actions.get-entry-details.props.filterVa: The value to filter by. For dates, use YYYY-MM-DD format or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS for specific times.
actions.get-entry-details.props.formIden: Select a Wufoo form to work with.
actions.get-entry-details.props.format.d: Choose the format for the API response. JSON is recommended for most integrations.
actions.get-entry-details.props.includeS: Include additional metadata like IP address, payment status, and completion status.
actions.get-entry-details.props.pageSize: Number of entries to return (maximum 100 per request).
actions.get-entry-details.props.pageStar: Starting entry number for pagination (0 = first entry).
actions.get-entry-details.props.sort.des: Sort results by field ID (e.g., EntryId, DateCreated, Field1). Leave blank for default order.
auth.description: Enter your Wufoo API Key and Subdomain.
auth.props.subdomain.description: Your Wufoo account subdomain (e.g., for fishbowl.wufoo.com, use "fishbowl")
triggers.new_form_created.description: Triggers when a new form is created in your Wufoo account.
triggers.new_form_created.props.includeI: Include forms that are not currently active/published. Useful for monitoring all form creation activity.
triggers.new_form_created.props.nameFilt: Only trigger for forms containing this text in their name. Leave empty to monitor all forms.
triggers.new_form_created.props.pollingI: How frequently to check for new forms. More frequent checking provides faster detection but uses more API calls.
triggers.new_form_created.props.response: Choose the format for form data. JSON is recommended for most workflows.
triggers.new_form_entry.description: Triggers when someone submits a new entry to your Wufoo form.
triggers.new_form_entry.props.formIdenti: Select a Wufoo form to work with.
triggers.new_form_entry.props.handshakeK: A secret key to validate webhook authenticity and prevent unauthorized requests. Recommended for production workflows.
triggers.new_form_entry.props.includeMet: Include detailed form and field structure information with each submission. Useful for dynamic processing but increases payload size.
triggers.new_form_entry.props.responseFo: Choose the format for webhook data. JSON is recommended for most automation workflows.
